column4: Returns the resource_metadata parameter of a Bearer challenge; the URL it returns is checked by check_destination and the document held to the configured resource by names, so it decides nothing.
Picks the resource_metadata parameter from one parsed challenge; decides nothing (the URL is checked downstream).
Splits a WWW-Authenticate value into challenges and parameters; a parser whose output is checked downstream.
Unescapes an RFC 9110 quoted-string; decides nothing.
